p.src: 1  Many times they have afflicted me from my youth up. Let Israel now say:

en: Many times they have afflicted me from my youth up. Let Israel now say:
u.src: 1  Many times they have afflicted me from my youth up. Let Israel now say:

p.src: 2  many times they have afflicted me from my youth up, yet they have not prevailed against me.

en: many times they have afflicted me from my youth up, yet they have not prevailed against me.
u.src: 2  many times they have afflicted me from my youth up, yet they have not prevailed against me.

p.src: 3  The plowers plowed on my back. They made their furrows long.

en: The plowers plowed on my back. They made their furrows long.
u.src: 3  The plowers plowed on my back. They made their furrows long.

p.src: 4  The LORD is righteous. He has cut apart the cords of the wicked.

en: The LORD is righteous. He has cut apart the cords of the wicked.
u.src: 4  The LORD is righteous. He has cut apart the cords of the wicked.

p.src: 5  Let them be disappointed and turned backward, all those who hate Zion.

en: Let them be disappointed and turned backward, all those who hate Zion.
u.src: 5  Let them be disappointed and turned backward, all those who hate Zion.

p.src: 6  Let them be as the grass on the housetops, which withers before it grows up,

en: Let them be as the grass on the housetops, which withers before it grows up,
u.src: 6  Let them be as the grass on the housetops, which withers before it grows up,

p.src: 7  with which the reaper doesn’t fill his hand, nor he who binds sheaves, his bosom.

en: with which the reaper doesn’t fill his hand, nor he who binds sheaves, his bosom.
u.src: 7  with which the reaper doesn’t fill his hand, nor he who binds sheaves, his bosom.

p.src: 8  Neither do those who go by say, “The blessing of the LORD be on you. We bless you in the LORD’s name.”

en: Neither do those who go by say, “The blessing of the LORD be on you. We bless you in the LORD’s name.”
